title: Editor MCP /status response (v1)
description: Wire-format contract for the editor-local (CLI) and desde-deployed (platform) MCP servers' status query. Both implementations import this schema. Cross-field invariants (e.g., scope=deployed implies dirty:false) are enforced by the validateStatusResponse() TS function — JSON Schema's expressiveness for cross-field rules is limited, so basic shape lives here and invariants live in the TS validator. Both layers run on every status reply in CI.

deployment_id.description: Latest deployment id this scope is tracking. Null on local when the branch has never deployed.

deployed_head_commit.description: Short SHA of the commit deployment_id was built from. Null when deployment_id is null.

branch.description: Git branch. Null on local in detached-HEAD state.

head_commit.description: Short SHA of HEAD. Null on local with unborn HEAD.

dirty.description: Working tree has uncommitted changes (local scope) or always false (deployed scope).

ahead_of_deployment.description: Whether the local view differs from the deployed view. Tri-state: true when local is ahead, false when they agree, 'unknown' when comparison is undefined (unborn HEAD, never-deployed branch).

last_edit_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 with timezone. Most recent edit timestamp.

warnings.description: Free-text non-fatal notes. Empty array when no warnings.
